## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the Issue and acceptance criteria. Explain the concrete change.

## Review evidence

- Exact head SHA:
- Files/areas changed:
- Local preview/run instructions:
- Commands actually executed and pass/fail/skip results:
- CI run/status:
- Known defects, blocked checks and limitations:
- Screenshots for visual changes:
- Security/privacy impact:
- DB/schema/migration impact:
- Ready for independent ChatGPT review:

## Acceptance gates

- [ ] Developer self-testing complete; skips and blocked checks disclosed
- [ ] Required CI green
- [ ] ChatGPT review/fix verification refers to the current head SHA
- [ ] Fiaz manual acceptance and appropriate independent automated checks
- [ ] Applicable Fiaz UI acceptance and independent AI QA merge

Developers must not self-approve or self-merge. Independent AI QA merges after applicable gates pass. Deployment requires separate authorization.
